name: WhatsApp
summary: Reduce metadata exposure, enable encrypted backups, and lock down account security.

settings.name: End-to-End Encrypted Backup
settings.impact: Without this, backups on Google Drive or iCloud are not end-to-end encrypted. Enabling it ensures WhatsApp and Apple/Google cannot decrypt your backup if compelled legally.
settings.source: EFF Surveillance Self-Defense (ssd.eff.org); Mozilla Foundation WhatsApp Privacy Review

settings.name: Two-Step Verification
settings.impact: Requires a PIN before WhatsApp can be registered on any new device with your number, blocking SIM-swap attacks and account hijacking.
settings.source: EFF Surveillance Self-Defense; Mozilla Foundation WhatsApp Privacy Review

settings.name: Protect IP Address in Calls
settings.impact: By default, WhatsApp calls are peer-to-peer, revealing your IP address to the other party. This routes calls through WhatsApp servers to hide your real IP.

settings.name: Advanced Chat Privacy
settings.impact: Prevents chat exports, disables automatic media downloads, and blocks Meta AI from reading the conversation. Enable on sensitive chats.
settings.source: EFF Deeplinks: 'What WhatsApp's Advanced Chat Privacy Really Does' (eff.org, 2025)

settings.name: Link Previews
settings.impact: When you send a link, WhatsApp fetches a preview from the URL, which can expose your WhatsApp version and allow tracking-pixel URLs to enumerate your account.
